name: Secret of the Ark
summary: Virtual Discovery's fictional escape game stories are based on the free and creative interpretation of historically proven or biblical events as well as myths and legends. The purpose of this escape game is exciting and unconditional entertainment and has no claim to impart knowledge, factual accuracy, scientifically recognized findings or educational aspects.
